//: K6 monitor configuration (docs/v6/k6-watcher-canary.md, docs/audit/2026-09-26/fixes-W2-monitor.md). Public identifiers only; the Telegram token is ALERT_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and the optional guardian key MONITOR_GUARDIAN_KEY, never here. Replace every <...> from deployments/canister-ic.json, deployments/stack-4663.json and the ceremony log.
//min_fee_pool_sats: the custody fee pool's minimum largest usable entry, in sats (default 20000; script/golive-check.sh --min-fee-pool-sats). Below it: SEV2. At or above it but under the conflict-out's 100,000-sat ceiling: an INFO note (in a large fee spike a stuck delivery is cancelled more slowly; the gated Wrapper keeps that from becoming a loss)
//builds: or inline: [{ "commit": "<git sha>", "buyer": "<buyer.wasm sha256>", "timelock": "<timelock.wasm sha256>", "timelock_rehearsal": "<timelock-rehearsal.wasm sha256>" }]
install_arg_hex: <the pre-handover reinstall's argument, as Candid hex (4449444c...), from the ceremony log>

evm.//stack: the stack file, inline (preferred: the image has no deployments/), or evm.stack_file (a path relative to this file); it names the registry, every wrapper, module and sweep vault
evm.//guardian: OPTIONAL (fixes-W2-monitor.md §1.4). Remove this block to run without a guardian. With it, MONITOR_GUARDIAN_KEY must be the key of this address (a fresh, code-less EOA with a little ETH), and registry.setGuardian(address) must have been made by the Safe

guardian.//pause_on_floor_walk: false (default): a floor walked at the band's edge pages SEV1 but the guardian does not pause on it (an honest keeper in a real crash posts at the edge too)
guardian.//pause_on_no_good_post_h: OPTIONAL (R3-check A3-I1, fixes-R4-services.md §8): hours without a good floor post after which the guardian pauses the keeper, so holders can burn (at the frozen floor, never above the backing: r4-contracts A3-M1) instead of waiting for the 7-day escape. Omit to never pause on it (a pause also stops draws and graduations); 12 is a reasonable value

evm.//rpcs: the canary's two providers, which must agree on every log. Measured 2026-09-26: rpc.ordofi.network answers every eth_getLogs with -32005 'busy' (fine for eth_call), robinhood.drpc.org serves eth_getLogs over ~100-block spans only (set its span in draws.providers). Two that serve logs: Robinhood and drpc
evm.//from_block: optional, and only EARLIER than the stack file's fromBlock (a later one is refused); normally leave it out

draws.//: fixes-R3-services.md §1: each provider keeps its own holder index (<state dir>/holders-<host>.json), read forward from a saved cursor; a root is verified when verify_quorum providers reproduce it. The exclusions are read from tools/snapshot/exclusions.json (shipped in the image); do not copy them here
draws.//deadline_s: an Open draw not verified this many seconds before its pin is SEV1, and (pause_unverified) the guardian pauses the keeper: requestDraw reverts while paused
draws.//pause_on_degraded: false (default, fixes-R4-services.md §3): at the deadline the guardian pauses only on evidence (a caught-up index computing another root, a dissent confirmed after a rebuild, a failure no degraded state explains); a draw unverified only because the providers are behind, stuck or throttled is SEV1 and escalated by hand. true: pause on any unverified draw (round 3's rule; outsiders can then cause pauses)
draws.//reconcile: true (default, R3-check L-F): a few coins a poll are checked against totalSupply()/balanceOf at the index's cursor, and rebuilt on a mismatch
